mostWorthwhile.text: The receiving laboratory's quiet reaction to the folded limbs was the most worthwhile passage; it gave the discovery room to register without explaining it away.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final board felt unnecessary because the chapter had no goals or actions.

surprise.text: The ending moved from the station seen in orbit to the receiving laboratory and another person's reaction.

arbitrary.text: There were no gameplay actions in this chapter to judge.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue and learn what the laboratory discovers, though this chapter offered no gameplay decisions to draw me onward.
